description: SEASONAL UPKEEP RESERVE: commit your own NET to a place's future upkeep, and see it, withdraw it, or tie it to a job on the board. You say, in plain words, what upkeep the place needs and how often (commit), or you end the record (withdraw), or you link one need in the active cycle to a packet you posted (link). FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas, and your NET never moves. A reserve is a record, never custody and never a lock: your NET stays in your own wallet, nothing is held or sent, and you can spend it or withdraw the record at any time. When you commit, the door checks the NET the cycles ahead are estimated to need (a house reference, not a price) against your wallet's fresh NET balance less everything it already stands behind, and refuses if it does not cover; nothing is recorded then. The work itself is posted, claimed, proven and accepted on the board by other people. The record stands, but no packet links, public ground included, until a person who is not you has verified the place. Preview the NET and the plan first with net_plan_commission. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the holder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_reserve within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit a new reserve, withdraw one you hold, or link one of its needs to a packet you posted.

commissionId.description: The reserve's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the reserve back.

cycle.description: link: the cycle this packet is for, 0 to 11. Cycle 0 is the active one until you renew.

cycleDays.description: commit: days in each cycle, 7 to 365.

needId.description: link: the id of the need this packet answers.

needs.description: commit: 1 to 12 needs, each { id (lowercase-dashes), objective (plain words, 5 to 300 characters), everyCycles (1 to 12), conditionId (optional, a Vealth Standard condition) }.

place.description: commit: { name, lat, lng }, the place in plain words (never a street address) and its pin.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that holds the reserve. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters.

siteAuthority.description: commit: { kind: public_ground | owner | manager | association, evidenceRef }. A private place needs the evidence reference (a deed, a parcel, a minute).

startAt.description: commit: when the first cycle is due, an ISO time.

workId.description: link: the packet's id on the board. You must have posted it with this same wallet.
